sn20.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn20.9:1.3: tena kho pana samaye nāññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati.
sn20.9:1.7: ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti kimaṅgaṃ panāhanti.
sn20.9:2.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhi vādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn20.9:2.2: idha bhante aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati
sn20.9:2.6: ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti kimaṅgaṃ panāhanti.
sn20.9:3.3: te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamūḷālaṃ abbhuggahetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkhā ditvā ajjhoharanti
sn20.9:3.4: tesantaṃ vaṇṇāya ceva hoti balāya ca na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.9:3.5: tesaññeva kho pana bhikkhave mahānāgānaṃ anusikkhamānā taruṇā bhikacchāpā te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamūḷālaṃ abbhuggahetvā na suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā sakaddamaṃ asaṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti
sn20.9:3.6: tesantaṃ neva vaṇṇāya hoti na balāya
sn20.9:3.7: tato nidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.9:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave idha therā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisanti
sn20.9:4.4: te taṃ lābhaṃ agadhitā amucchitā anajjhāpannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti
sn20.9:4.5: tesantaṃ vaṇṇāya ceva hoti balāya ca na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.9:4.6: tesaññeva kho pana bhikkhave therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anusikkhamānānaṃ vā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisanti
sn20.9:4.9: te taṃ lābhaṃ gadhitā mucchitā ajjhāpannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti
sn20.9:4.10: tesantaṃ neva vaṇṇāya hoti na balāya tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.9:4.12: agadhitā amucchitā anajjhāpannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjissāmāti
